difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a flat morphism f : X -> Y of locally Noetherian algebraic spaces over S which is locally of finite type and of relative dimension d, one has dim_x(X) = dim_y(Y) + d at every point x with image y (source lines 6834-6840). The proof unwinds both the definition of the dimension of an algebraic space at a point and the definition of relative dimension d, reducing the statement to the corresponding statement for morphisms of schemes.
